acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Default gob snapshot has no content integrity check (storage high; 1/2). Agreed and reproduced: a same-length body overwrite is served as a hit with the real blob_hash, `context --task` returns `supported` for text the blob does not contain, and `index --if-stale` reports fresh 29/30 times; the lifecycle qualification corrupts offset 100 only (`script/check-install-lifecycle.sh:234`). Split: decision 0210 reproduced this and chose not to add a 44 ms digest check. Settles it: the owner either accepts the cost (a payload SHA-256 in the header, verified on load and in `ProbeSnapshot`) or narrows `docs/INSTALL.md:338-340` and `stable-operations-v0.md:41,99`, which currently claim any byte-corrupted `*.gob` is a miss. The claim as written is false today and must change one way or the other before rc.1.

completion.reason: Fixed in 1e867c20 (SHA-256 trailer verified on every gob snapshot read). Contained in the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate 94ca556f52c0349c0a48e0c3a3274f8a0b5e6db3 on origin/main. Owner-approved closure 2026-09-27.

title: panel D5: Default gob snapshot has no content integrity check
